q: We all _____ a debt of gratitude to Mrs Stevenson for her years of service.
translation: 我们都因史蒂文森夫人多年的服务而欠她一份感激之情。

q: With a flash of _____ I realized what the dream meant.
explain: insight n. 洞察力、深刻的理解。
translation: 灵光一闪，我明白了那个梦的含义。

q: She provides a clear and _____ account of the events.
explain: insightful adj. 富有洞察力的、有深刻见解的。
translation: 她对那些事件提供了清晰而富有洞察力的叙述。

q: A long line of cars _____ into the distance along the coast road.
explain: stretch v. 伸展、延伸、拉长。
translation: 一长串汽车沿着海岸公路一直延伸到远方。

q: She used to read for hours at a _____ without taking any break.
explain: stretch n. 连续的一段时间、一段路程。
translation: 她过去常常连续读几个小时而不休息。

q: Just signing your name on a Christmas card seems too _____.
explain: impersonal adj. 没有人情味的、冷淡的。
translation: 只在圣诞卡上签个名显得太没有人情味了。

q: The novel is written from the author's _____ experience of growing up in a small town.
explain: personal adj. 个人的、私人的。
translation: 这部小说是根据作者在小镇成长的个人经历写成的。

q: She announced that she would _____ for a seat on the city council next year.
explain: run v. 争取获得（职位、席位等）、竞选。
translation: 她宣布明年将竞选市议会的一个席位。

q: He _____ that he would never tell anyone about what he had seen.
explain: swear v. 郑重承诺、发誓。
translation: 他发誓永远不会把看到的事情告诉任何人。

q: A second bomb _____ in a crowded market near the station.
translation: 第二枚炸弹在车站附近一个拥挤的市场里爆炸了。

q: There were two loud _____ and then the building burst into flames.
translation: 传来两声巨响，随后大楼燃起了熊熊大火。

q: Because the gas is highly _____, workers must handle it with great care.
explain: explosive adj. 易爆炸的、可能引起爆炸的。
translation: 由于这种气体极易爆炸，工人必须极其小心地处理它。

q: The bomb was packed with several pounds of high _____.
translation: 炸弹里装了几磅高性能炸药。

q: The _____ family attended the ceremony wearing traditional clothes.
explain: royal adj. 王室的、皇家的。
translation: 王室成员穿着传统服装出席了仪式。

q: The gala evening was attended by _____ and politicians from across the country.
translation: 来自全国各地的王室成员和政界人士出席了这场晚会。

q: Winston Churchill and Richard Nixon were both _____ figures in history.
translation: 温斯顿·丘吉尔和理查德·尼克松都是历史上颇有争议的人物。

q: The _____ surrounding his latest movie continues to attract public attention.
translation: 围绕他最新电影的争议持续吸引着公众的关注。

q: Women are traditionally supposed to be good at _____.
explain: multitasking n. 同时处理多项任务。
translation: 传统上认为女性擅长同时处理多项任务。

q: The _____ president gave a speech at the university last week.
explain: former adj. 以前的、前任的。
translation: 前总统上周在大学发表了演讲。

q: The _____ part of the article explores three possible solutions to the problem.
explain: latter adj. 后半的、接近末尾的。
translation: 文章的后半部分探讨了该问题的三种可能解决方案。

q: He presented two solutions, and the _____ seems much better to most people.
translation: 他提出了两个解决方案，在大多数人看来后者要好得多。

q: _____ is a problem for many people in western countries.
explain: obesity n. 肥胖，过度肥胖。
translation: 肥胖是西方国家许多人都面临的一个问题。

q: _____ people tend to have higher blood pressure than lean people.
explain: obese adj. 肥胖的，臃肿的。
translation: 肥胖的人血压往往比瘦人高。

q: He has not visited the country _____ since his election.
explain: officially adv. 正式地，官方地。
translation: 自当选以来，他还没有正式访问过这个国家。

q: An _____ inquiry has been launched into the cause of the accident.
explain: official adj. 官方的，正式的。
translation: 已经对事故原因启动了官方调查。

q: She is the government _____ in charge of the project.
translation: 她是负责该项目的政府官员。

q: Clearance of the site required the _____ of a number of trees.
translation: 清理场地需要移除若干树木。

q: What do you advise for _____ ink from my clothes?
translation: 你有什么建议可以去除我衣服上的墨水？

q: For the police, the incident was nothing out of the _____.
explain: ordinary adj. 普通的，平常的。
translation: 对警方来说，这起事件毫无异常之处。

q: She has excellent _____ in dress and always looks elegant.
translation: 她在穿着方面品位出众，看起来总是很优雅。

q: Our government should reflect the racial and _____ diversity of our country.
explain: ethnic adj. 种族的，民族的。
translation: 我们的政府应当体现我国的种族与民族多样性。

q: I hated the organization and all it _____ for.
explain: stand v. 代表，象征（stand for）。
translation: 我厌恶那个组织，也厌恶它所代表的一切。

q: The novel was read on the radio in five _____.
explain: installment n. 一期，一部分（连载或分期付款的）。
translation: 这部小说在电台分五期播出。

q: There were no signs that the fire had been set _____.
explain: deliberately adv. 故意地，蓄意地。
translation: 没有迹象表明这场火是有人故意放的。

q: The speech was a _____ attempt to embarrass the government.
explain: deliberate adj. 故意的，蓄意的。
translation: 那次讲话是蓄意让政府难堪的举动。

q: The jury _____ for five days before finding him guilty.
explain: deliberate v. 仔细考虑，商议。
translation: 陪审团经过五天的仔细考虑才裁定他有罪。

q: I am very much _____ that not everyone agrees with me.
explain: aware adj. 意识到的，知道的。
translation: 我非常清楚并非每个人都同意我的看法。

q: Public _____ of the problem will make politicians take it seriously.
translation: 公众对这一问题的认识将促使政客们认真对待它。

q: Smokers who inhale are likely to become _____ to nicotine.
explain: addicted adj. 上瘾的，成瘾的。
translation: 吸入烟雾的吸烟者很可能对尼古丁上瘾。

q: He's only 24 years old and a drug _____.
explain: addict n. 上瘾的人，入迷的人。
translation: 他只有24岁，却是个吸毒成瘾的人。

q: His tastes _____ him to the study of antiquity.
explain: addict v. 使上瘾，使沉溺。
translation: 他的爱好使他沉溺于对古物的研究。

q: Many thanks to all who have _____ comments on the website.
translation: 非常感谢所有在网站上发表了评论的人。

q: The cost of _____ a letter has gone up again, so I rarely use the post now.
translation: 寄信的费用又上涨了，所以我现在很少用邮政了。

q: I called the office to _____ them on the day's developments.
explain: update v. 更新、向…提供最新信息。
translation: 我打电话给办公室，向他们通报当天的事态发展。

q: The police have issued an _____ on the investigation into the missing child.
explain: update n. 更新、最新消息。
translation: 警方发布了关于失踪儿童调查的最新情况。

q: The participants in the study were not _____ of the purpose of the task.
translation: 研究的参与者事先没有被告知任务的目的。

q: We _____ for hours with the problem of which job to do first.
explain: wrestle v. 摔跤、奋力对付。
translation: 我们为先做哪项工作的问题纠结了好几个小时。

q: He chose his words with _____, as if he were a lawyer.
translation: 他措辞精确，仿佛是一名律师。

q: The _____ cause of the accident is still unknown, so the police are investigating.
explain: precise adj. 精确的，准确的。
translation: 事故的确切原因仍然未知，因此警方正在调查。

q: The train arrived at _____ eight o'clock, just as the schedule said.
translation: 火车正好在八点到达，正如时刻表所说。

q: The traffic in the city is _____ in the rush hour.
translation: 高峰时段城市交通一片混乱。

q: The house was in complete _____ after the party, with bottles and food everywhere.
translation: 聚会后房子里一片混乱，到处都是瓶子和食物。

q: The plates were in _____ stacks according to size, ready for the dinner.
explain: orderly adj. 有秩序的，整齐的。
translation: 盘子按大小整齐地叠放着，为晚宴做好了准备。

q: Shut the window, _____ it'll get too cold in here.
translation: 关上窗户，否则这里会太冷。

q: He was unwilling to _____ this responsibility alone, so he asked for help.
translation: 他不愿意独自承担这个责任，所以寻求帮助。

q: She carried the heavy bag on her _____ all the way to the station.
translation: 她一路把沉重的包扛在肩上到了车站。

q: We have no way of predicting next year's weather _____, according to the expert.
translation: 据专家说，我们无法预测明年的天气模式。

q: A police helicopter _____ overhead while the officers searched the building.
translation: 一架警用直升机在空中盘旋，同时警察搜查了那栋建筑。

q: To my great _____, she remembered my name after all these years.
translation: 令我万分惊讶的是，过了这么多年她居然还记得我的名字。

q: The size of the ancient temple _____ all the visitors who came to see it.
translation: 古庙的规模让所有前来参观的游客都感到惊讶。

q: She looked at her daughter in _____ as the child recited the poem.
translation: 当孩子背诵那首诗时，她惊奇地看着女儿。

q: I _____ why he left his job without telling anyone about his plans.
explain: wonder v. 想知道、感到惊讶。
translation: 我想知道他为什么没有告诉任何人他的计划就辞职了。

q: The Grand Canyon is one of the natural _____ of the world.
translation: 大峡谷是世界自然奇观之一。

q: She looked at him in _____ when he told her the news.
translation: 当他告诉她这个消息时，她惊愕地看着他。

q: It never ceases to _____ me what some people will do for money.
translation: 有些人为了钱会做出什么事，总是让我感到惊讶。

q: The promotion he had been promised failed to _____, so he started looking for another job.
explain: materialize v. 实现、突然出现。
translation: 他曾经被承诺的晋升未能实现，所以他开始寻找另一份工作。

q: The _____ of new technologies has changed the way we communicate with each other.
translation: 新技术的出现改变了我们彼此交流的方式。

q: Three major themes _____ from this research, according to the report.
translation: 根据报告，这项研究得出了三个主要主题。

q: The ease with which she learns languages is _____ to everyone who meets her.
translation: 她学习语言的那种轻松程度让每个遇见她的人都感到惊讶。

q: His resignation has created a _____ which cannot easily be filled.
translation: 他的辞职造成了一个难以轻易填补的空缺。

q: She _____ the whole house before the guests arrived for the party.
explain: vacuum v. 用吸尘器打扫。
translation: 在客人来参加聚会之前，她用吸尘器打扫了整个房子。

q: He passed the exam with _____, surprising his teachers who thought he would struggle.
translation: 他轻松通过了考试，这让那些以为他会吃力的老师们感到惊讶。

q: The medicine helped to _____ the pain in her back after the injury.
translation: 药物帮助减轻了她受伤后背部的疼痛。

q: The report showed a clear _____ against women in the workplace.
translation: 该报告显示工作场所中存在对女性的明显偏见。

q: The writer's personal experience _____ his account of the event.
translation: 作者的个人经历使他对事件的描述带有偏见。

q: The new policy gave a _____ to small businesses.
explain: boost n. 促进，推动、增长。
translation: 新政策给小企业带来了推动。

q: The new resort area has _____ tourism considerably.
explain: boost v. 促进，推动，增加。
translation: 新的度假区极大地促进了旅游业。

q: The prisoner was _____ to a chair with rope.
translation: 囚犯被绳子绑在椅子上。

q: Being late for the meeting put him in a real _____.
translation: 开会迟到使他陷入了真正的困境。

q: He has a _____ mind and notices everything.
explain: sharp adj. 机敏的，敏锐的。
translation: 他头脑机敏，注意到一切。

q: We first build up a detailed _____ of our customers and their requirements.
translation: 我们首先建立客户及其需求的详细概况。

q: The magazine _____ several young artists in its latest issue.
explain: profile v. 撰写简介，描述。
translation: 这本杂志在最新一期中介绍了几位年轻艺术家。

q: He grabbed me and _____ my arm behind my back.
translation: 他抓住我，把我的手臂扭到背后。

q: The story has an interesting _____ at the end.
explain: twist n. 转折，意外变化。
translation: 故事结尾有一个有趣的转折。

q: Work is urgently needed to repair our decaying _____.
translation: 迫切需要动工修复我们日益破败的基础设施。

q: Domestic policy was soon _____ by political unrest abroad.
explain: overshadow v. 使显得逊色、给…蒙上阴影。
translation: 国内政策很快被国外的政治动荡蒙上了阴影。

q: We need more chairs because there are not enough to go _____.
explain: round adv. （足够）分配地、（在人群中）传递。
translation: 我们需要更多椅子，因为没有足够的椅子供大家分配。

q: He has a _____ face and a friendly smile.
translation: 他有一张圆脸和友好的微笑。

q: The next _____ of talks begins on Monday.
translation: 下一轮会谈星期一开始。

q: She _____ the corner and disappeared from sight.
translation: 她转过街角，从视线中消失了。

q: There does not appear to be _____ agreement on the future of the British monarchy.
explain: universal adj. 普遍的，全体的。
translation: 关于英国君主制的未来，似乎并不存在普遍的共识。

q: Music is often called a _____ because it crosses borders.
explain: universal n. 普遍存在的事物，共性。
translation: 音乐常被称为一种共性，因为它跨越国界。

q: As far as we know, the entire _____ was created in the big bang.
translation: 据我们所知，整个宇宙是在大爆炸中产生的。

q: Walker's work has been the _____ of much debate.
translation: 沃克的作品一直是许多争论的主题。

q: All prices are _____ to change without notice.
explain: subject adj. 易受…影响的、取决于。
translation: 所有价格都可能变动，恕不另行通知。

q: The researchers _____ the metal to high temperatures.
explain: subject v. 使经受，使遭受。
translation: 研究人员使金属经受高温。
